about: Cases every reader of an agent's session file must pass (spec/agents.md "Conversation"): the file's lines (a record as JSON, or a line as it is), in; the entries the person's devices are sent, out. 'claude': Claude Code's file, read as its manifest maps it (session.transcript), the records shaped as Claude Code 2.1.287 writes them (2.1.296 for a tool that asks the person questions, 2.1.303 for what its program writes as if the person said it). 'mapped': the mapping rules themselves, a mapping and records shaped as another agent might keep them. 'phone': what a phone reads of the entries a device sends it (an answer's entries, in; those it reads, out). Written by hand from the spec.
